profile_text.body:
Founders Fund is a venture capital firm based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2005, according to its website. The firm describes itself as investing in companies building revolutionary technologies. Its site carries a copyright notice covering 2005 to 2026 and states that Founders Fund is a registered trademark of Founders Fund, LLC. It also states that past performance is not indicative of future results, that investments may lose value, and that nothing on the site is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy securities.

The site does not describe any products of its own, presenting the firm as an investor rather than a maker of software or services. Its recorded litigation exposure is in California, with 270 matters.
